_comment: Template for the Phase 0 concept graph. Copy to data/concepts.seed.json and fill in.
Target 150-300 nodes for one subject + grade. This file shows one chapter's worth
prereqIds is the part that has to be right. It drives frontier gating (never drill
a learner on something they cannot yet do) and upstream gap detection (when they
fail here, which earlier concept is actually missing). Author these by hand from
the syllabus, using a model as a drafting assistant - do not let it generate the
depth is computed by the loader; omit it.

concepts.name: Right triangles: sides and naming
concepts.description: Identifying the hypotenuse, and the opposite and adjacent sides relative to a chosen acute angle in a right triangle.
objectives: Name the three sides relative to a given acute angle
Recognise that opposite and adjacent swap when the reference angle changes

concepts.name: Pythagoras' theorem
concepts.description: In a right triangle the square on the hypotenuse equals the sum of the squares on the other two sides.
objectives: Find a missing side given the other two
Verify whether a triple forms a right triangle

concepts.name: Trigonometric ratios
concepts.description: Definitions of sin, cos and tan of an acute angle as ratios of sides in a right triangle, and the reciprocal ratios cosec, sec and cot.
objectives: Write all six ratios for a given angle
Compute a ratio from a labelled triangle
State the reciprocal relationships

concepts.name: Ratios of 0, 30, 45, 60 and 90 degrees
concepts.description: Exact values of the trigonometric ratios at the standard angles, derived from the 30-60-90 and 45-45-90 triangles rather than memorised.
objectives: State exact values without a table
Derive the 30-60-90 values from an equilateral triangle
Evaluate expressions combining standard angles

concepts.name: The identity sin^2 + cos^2 = 1
concepts.description: The first Pythagorean identity, obtained by applying Pythagoras' theorem to the ratio definitions.
objectives: Derive the identity from Pythagoras' theorem
Use it to find one ratio given another
Recognise it inside a larger expression

concepts.name: Derived identities: sec, cosec, cot forms
concepts.description: The second and third Pythagorean identities, obtained by dividing the first through by cos^2 and sin^2.
objectives: Derive both from the first identity
Choose the useful identity for a given expression

concepts.name: Proving and simplifying trigonometric expressions
concepts.description: Strategy for proving an identity: work one side only, convert to sin and cos when stuck, look for a Pythagorean form to substitute.
objectives: Prove an identity working from one side
Recognise when to convert everything to sin and cos
Avoid the invalid move of operating across both sides

concepts.name: Angles of elevation and depression
concepts.description: Modelling a real situation as a right triangle, distinguishing the angle of elevation from the angle of depression relative to the horizontal.
objectives: Draw a correct diagram from a word problem
Distinguish elevation from depression
Solve single-triangle height and distance problems

concepts.name: Height and distance with two triangles
concepts.description: Problems requiring two right triangles sharing a side, solved by forming and eliminating between two equations.
objectives: Identify the shared side between two triangles
Set up and solve the resulting simultaneous equations
